findings: DirectMediaRepositoryImpl now whole-read, 1313 lines. Prior partial findings remain qualified source observations.

scanPathsAndWait resumes true after a number of callbacks equal to requested paths, ignoring null URI and path identity. It has no timeout or deduplication of callbacks; missing callbacks can leave it suspended until cancellation. No Android callback simulation run.

getAllMediaFilePaths scans primary external-storage root by extension, skips dot directories and Android-prefix paths, but does not exclude processed/permanently sorted/translated To Edit folders. Thus duplicate scan discovery differs from folder-selection discovery intentionally or otherwise.

getMediaItemsFromPaths queries all MediaStore image/video records before processing the requested list; small scoped scans still load the global metadata map. Full-resolution fallback dimension probing remains a potential cost.
FolderDetailsCache conversion recomputes isPrimarySystemFolder from standard paths, resolving the missing-persistent-field concern recorded in v11.
Directory read exceptions are logged and omitted rather than propagated as coverage diagnostics. A scan can return a set without indicating inaccessible subtrees to the higher-level result.
triggerFullMediaStoreScan only submits paths not already known to MediaStore; it does not refresh metadata for existing records despite full-scan naming.
